details.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct is a 32.5-billion-parameter, instruction-tuned code model from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team, released in November 2024 as the flagship of the Qwen2.5-Coder series. It is built for code generation, code repair, and code reasoning, and was pretrained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data before instruction tuning. The Qwen team describes its coding ability as matching GPT-4o on multiple benchmarks while also retaining general and mathematical competency. It is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
advantages: Scores 92.7% on HumanEval and 90.2% on MBPP code-generation benchmarks, per the Qwen2.5-Coder technical report.
Averages 79.4% across MultiPL-E, a benchmark spanning multiple programming languages, per the technical report.
Reports 60.9% pass@1 and 73.7% pass@2 on the Aider code-editing benchmark, which Qwen describes as comparable to GPT-4o.
Scores 65.9 on McEval and leads open-source models with 75.2 on MdEval, per the Qwen2.5-Coder blog, both benchmarks covering dozens of programming languages.
Retains strong general and math ability, scoring 93.0% on GSM8K and 76.4% on MATH, per the technical report.
disadvantages: Scores markedly lower on harder tasks: 27.0% on the BigCodeBench-Hard subset versus 49.6% on the full BigCodeBench set, per the technical report.
The model card lists English as the primary instruction language, despite broad programming-language coverage.
Extending context beyond the base 32,768-token configuration requires enabling YaRN scaling, which the model card notes can reduce performance on shorter texts.
use_cases: Generating and completing code across 40+ programming languages.
Code repair and debugging, including multi-language fixes as tested by MdEval.
Code reasoning and step-by-step program execution analysis (CRUXEval).
Integration into AI coding assistants and IDE tools such as Cursor, per the Qwen blog.
Building code agents for real-world software engineering tasks, per the model card.

notes: Catalog lists a 32,768-token input/output limit for this hyperbolicai route; the Qwen model card describes that as the base config and states full support up to 131,072 tokens is available via YaRN scaling — the catalog's 32,768 value was kept per instructions. The GitHub repo QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Coder now documents the newer Qwen3-Coder series rather than this model, though no deprecation notice was found on the Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct model card itself, so github_url was left null. Tool/function-calling support is not documented on the pages checked, so it was left out of both advantages and disadvantages.
